Metadata.title: Nodvis Finance
Metadata.description: A private, self-hosted household finance control center.

HomePage.title: Your financial situation without the accounting clutter.
HomePage.description: A clear, real-time snapshot of available funds, upcoming obligations, and household debt.
HomePage.noData: No data yet — the financial model is being implemented.

next.title: Next stage
next.description: Household, accounts, cash, balances, categories, manual transactions and transfers — without double-counting money movements or collapsing available cash into debt.

Auth.signInDescription: Enter your email and password to access household transactions.
Auth.noHouseholdDescription: This user account is not linked to any household in the system yet.

Onboarding.title: Create your household
Onboarding.description: Set up your household to begin managing funds, accounts, and obligations.
Onboarding.errorGeneric: Failed to create household. Please check your input and try again.

HouseholdSelection.title: Select household
HouseholdSelection.description: You belong to multiple households. Choose which one you want to view.

Accounts.title: Accounts & balances
Accounts.description: Manage bank accounts, savings, cash wallets, and credit cards with exact balance snapshots.
Accounts.emptyActiveDescription: Add your first bank account, cash wallet, or credit card below.
Accounts.emptyArchivedDescription: No archived accounts in this household.
Accounts.archiveConfirm: Archive this account? History and transactions will remain intact.

form.name: Account name
form.namePlaceholder: e.g. Main Checking, Home Cash, Visa Card
form.ownersHelp: Select who in the household owns this account.
form.initialBalanceHelp: Leave empty if the balance is unknown. Decimals are parsed with exact minor units.
form.creditCardNotice: For credit cards, enter negative value for outstanding debt (e.g. -250.00).
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the account.
form.errorOwnersRequired: Please select at least one owner.

Categories.title: Categories
Categories.description: Organize expenses and income with household-scoped categories.
Categories.emptyArchivedDescription: No archived categories in this household.
Categories.archiveConfirm: Archive this category? Historical transactions will retain this category.

form.name: Category name
form.applicabilityHelp: Specify whether this category applies to expenses, income, or both.
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the category.
form.errorDuplicateName: A category with this name already exists in this household.

Transactions.sectionDescription: Record expenses, income, and transfers between owned accounts while preserving financial rules.

form.categoryHelp: Optional. Assign an active category to this transaction.
form.amountHelp: Enter amount in decimal format (e.g. 123.45 or 100). Both dot and comma are accepted.
form.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving the transaction.
form.transferInvariantNotice: Per financial rules, an internal transfer is neither income nor spending and does not change total household funds (INV-001).
form.transferRequiresTwoAccounts: At least two accounts are required in the household to record a transfer.
form.transferSameAccountError: Source and destination accounts must be different.
form.transferCurrencyMismatchError: Transfers are only supported between accounts with the same currency.
form.transferNoMatchingCurrency: No other account shares the same currency as the selected source account.
form.noAccounts: No accounts in the household yet. Please add an account to record transactions.
form.amountRequired: Enter a valid positive amount greater than zero (e.g. 123.45).

details.title: Transaction details
details.auditTrailNotice: This transaction record is permanently preserved for audit integrity.

history.title: Change history
history.description: Trustworthy immutable audit trail of all recorded modifications to this transaction.
history.loadError: Failed to load change history. Please try again.
history.baselineNotice: Initial baseline prior to change tracking

edit.description: Correct this transaction. Balance snapshots and audit history remain safe.
edit.errorConflict: This transaction was modified elsewhere. Please refresh to see the latest version.
edit.errorGeneric: An error occurred while saving corrections.

void.title: Void transaction
void.description: Voiding removes this transaction from active balance effects without deleting it. The audit record, timestamp, and optional reason will be preserved permanently.
void.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Duplicate entry, wrong amount entered, returned purchase
void.errorConflict: This transaction was modified or already voided. Please refresh.
void.errorGeneric: An error occurred while voiding the transaction.

list.title: Recent transactions
list.description: Recorded financial operations in the household.
list.emptyVoidedDescription: No transactions have been voided in this household.
list.emptyDescription: No transactions have been recorded in this household yet. Use the form above to add an expense, income, or transfer.

filters.title: Filter transactions
filters.noResultsDescription: No transactions matched the selected filters. Try changing or clearing your criteria.

Footer.tagline: Nodvis Finance — private, self-hosted household finance control center.
Footer.privacyNote: All financial data and operations remain under your exclusive control on your local server.

availableCash.allFresh: Observed from all {count} active asset accounts
availableCash.partialWarning: Partial data: {count} account(s) have unrecorded or stale balance
availableCash.staleWarning: {count} account(s) excluded due to stale snapshot (>30 days)

upcoming.title: Upcoming obligations
upcoming.notModeled: Upcoming obligations are not yet modeled
upcoming.note: Scheduled bills and future commitments will appear here when modeled.

debt.title: Debt & liabilities
debt.notModeled: Debt obligations are not yet modeled
debt.note: Loans and liability schedules are kept strictly separate from available cash.

cashFlow.title: Cash flow for {period}
cashFlow.description: Actual executed movements in the selected period (transfers excluded).
cashFlow.emptyTitle: No cash flow in this period
cashFlow.emptyDescription: No income or spending transactions have been recorded for {period}.

categorySpending.title: Spending by category
categorySpending.description: Breakdown of expenses recorded in this period.
categorySpending.emptyDescription: No category spending has been recorded for {period}.

observations.title: Account observations status
observations.staleAccount: Account “{name}” ({currency}) snapshot was taken on {date} (stale, >30 days).
